title: Vendor Email: Seat Renewal and Forecast AI Demo Offer

fields.subject: Action needed: seat renewal + free Forecast AI trial
fields.body:
Hi Tamsin!

I hope your week is going well. Just a quick reminder that your 40-seat licence renews on 31 March. I've attached the renewal quote so you have it to hand.

Here's the good news: if you sign the attached quote today, we'll add our new Forecast AI module free for 90 days. It automatically predicts surges from news events! It reads local news and social trends and suggests extra staff before the volume arrives, so your schedulers can get ahead of the busy days.

I'm free for a 30-minute demo at 16:30 or 17:00 today. Just reply with the time that works best and I'll send a meeting link.

Could you also confirm the number of active schedulers by end of day? That way the quote matches what you're actually using.

Thanks so much, and talk soon!
fields.signature:
Brennan Tull
Account Manager, Public Sector & Health
Rosterline Workforce Solutions
402-555-0147 | b.tull@shiftgrid-software.example

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The Workforce Coordinator should defer the vendor with a one-line reply, book no demo, and stay on the overnight cover check. Give credit if she adds "surge forecast late" to the after-action list instead of taking up the AI pitch now.
